commentary.text: 90+5' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+4' One of the players from Betis times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
90+2' Betis are ruled offside.
90+2' Juan Miranda (Betis) takes just a short run up and his weak free kick from the edge of the box is blocked by the defensive wall.
90+1' The foul by Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Cesar Soto Grado.
90' 4 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' The resulting set piece from Betis is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
90' Isco (Betis) picks up a precise pass deep inside the box, but his strike is saved by the keeper. Betis have been awarded a corner kick.

89' Ayoze Perez (Betis) latches on to a precise defence-splitting pass and fires a nice strike from a promising distance towards the left post. Unai Simon has a clear sight of it and makes a comfortable save.
87' Wow, what an escape. Borja Iglesias (Betis) has an effort from inside the box but it's brilliantly blocked.
85' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Inigo Ruiz de Galarreta departs the field of play to be replaced by Dani Garcia (Ath Bilbao).
84' 4 - 2 Goal! Unai Gomez (Ath Bilbao) slots the ball into an unguarded net from close range after a shot rebounds off a defender. 4:2.
83' The defence had a hard time blocking out the strike from Rodri (Betis). He didn't hesitate and finished from outside the box right after he had received a pass from his teammate.
82' The attendance is 44340.
79' Mikel Vesga (Ath Bilbao) violates the rules and gets a yellow card.
79' Ath Bilbao fail to score from a corner as Rui Silva (Betis) leaps to collect the ball.

79' Inigo Ruiz de Galarreta (Ath Bilbao) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away. Ath Bilbao force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
77' Cesar Soto Grado couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Inigo Ruiz de Galarreta (Ath Bilbao) and blew his whistle.
75' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Nico Williams as he is replaced by Asier Villalibre (Ath Bilbao).
74' Manuel Pellegrini decides to make a substitution. Marc Roca will be replaced by Andres Guardado (Betis).
74' Today's match ends for Willian Jose who will be replaced by Borja Iglesias (Betis).
71' Aitor Paredes (Ath Bilbao) makes a strong challenge and Cesar Soto Grado blows for a foul.
66' We are about to witness a subsitution. Unai Gomez (Ath Bilbao) for Iker Muniain.
66' Ernesto Valverde Tejedor has decided to make a change. Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) replaces Gorka Guruzeta.
66' Imanol Garcia de Albeniz comes off the pitch to be replaced by Yuri Berchiche (Ath Bilbao).
65' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Guido Rodriguez leaves the pitch and Paul Akouokou (Betis) comes on.
64' What a save from Rui Silva! Gorka Guruzeta (Ath Bilbao) jumps high to meet a cross and glances a promising header from close range, but the goalkeeper pulls off a brilliant stop to keep it out.
61' Inigo Ruiz de Galarreta (Ath Bilbao) will have to be careful for the rest of the match as he is shown a yellow card.
61' Ath Bilbao take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
60' A cross into the box from Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) is cleared. The ball goes out for a corner. Ath Bilbao can continue in their attacking effort.
59' Aitor Paredes (Ath Bilbao) sees a yellow card from Cesar Soto Grado after he sent one of the opposing players to the ground.
58' Here comes a substitution. Abner is given a rest as he is replaced by Juan Miranda (Betis).
57' Manuel Pellegrini prepares a substitution. Aitor Ruibal is replaced by Rodri (Betis).
55' Imanol Garcia de Albeniz (Ath Bilbao) was too forceful with his tackle and Cesar Soto Grado interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
51' The game is interrupted. Aitor Paredes (Ath Bilbao) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did.
48' Today's referee Cesar Soto Grado rightly decides to book Abner (Betis) for his harsh tackle.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+10' The end of the first half.
45+7' 3 - 2 Gorka Guruzeta (Ath Bilbao) receives a brilliant pass inside the box from Inaki Williams, and beats the goalkeeper with a shot into the roof of the net. He makes it 3:2.

45+6' Marc Roca (Betis) clutches his head in despair after he blew a huge opportunity! He received the ball from the free kick, took a good first touch and unleashed a projectile from close range to the left side of the goal, but Unai Simon makes a nice save.
45+5' Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) commits a rough challenge and Cesar Soto Grado blows his whistle for a foul.

45+4' Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) goes on a mazy run, skips past two defenders and pulls the trigger in front of the keeper. Rui Silva makes a decent save to deny his effort directed to the middle of the target.

45+2' What an opportunity! Gorka Guruzeta (Ath Bilbao) squanders a huge opportunity as he latches on to a perfect cross from the wing. He produces a bullet header from around the penalty spot which goes just wide of the left post!
45' 8 additional min. will be played.
45' 2 - 2 Mikel Vesga (Ath Bilbao) keeps his cool and converts the penalty.
45' Mikel Vesga (Ath Bilbao) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
44' Cesar Soto Grado shows a yellow card to Guido Rodriguez (Betis), who isn't surprised as the tackle was really hard and late.
44' The Ath Bilbao players are happy as the referee awards a PENALTY after the VAR review!

43' It's been a while since that incident in the box, but the ref must have received some information as he makes the VAR signal. He's going to review that earlier penalty shout! What a chance for Ath Bilbao.
43' Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) breaks into the box and goes over after a challenge from an opposition player, but the ref signals NO penalty!
41' Inigo Lekue (Ath Bilbao) is penalised for a foul. Cesar Soto Grado had a clear view and blows his whistle.
38' Inigo Lekue (Ath Bilbao) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
35' Iker Muniain (Ath Bilbao) latches onto a short pass just on the edge of the box and shoots. The effort beats the keeper but comes back off the left post. Close!
33' Ayoze Perez (Betis) fires a shot well wide of the right post from inside the box after latching onto a short pass.
30' 1 - 2 GOAL! That’s a great strike from the spot by Mikel Vesga (Ath Bilbao) low into the right of the net, giving goalkeeper Rui Silva no chance!
30' Mikel Vesga (Ath Bilbao) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
30' Referee Cesar Soto Grado sees the trip by Rui Silva (Betis) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle. It's a penalty! Great chance to score for Ath Bilbao!
26' Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) does his best to latch onto a cross into the box, but he can't get to the ball.
22' Betis quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
18' A goal, which was scored by Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao), was disallowed due to offside.
17' Iker Muniain (Ath Bilbao) will take the corner.
17' Abner (Betis) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Cesar Soto Grado has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
14' Iker Muniain (Ath Bilbao) takes the corner and sends it into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and makes a good clearance.
14' Iker Muniain (Ath Bilbao) lifts the ball into the box from the corner, but one of the defending players gets there first to head it clear.
13' Dani Vivian (Ath Bilbao) connects with a cross from out wide in the six-yard box, but only plants his header onto the bar.
12' Abner (Betis) brings his opponent down with a tackle and Cesar Soto Grado blows his whistle for a foul.
10' 0 - 2 Isco (Betis) has acres of space after latching on to a precise pass into the box. He doesn't hesitate to unleash a great effort which ends up in the left side of the goal.
9' The linesman raises his flag for offside before Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) heads on.
7' Inigo Lekue (Ath Bilbao) put a cross into the box which wasn't a bad decision, but he failed to achieve what he wanted as none of his teammates managed to meet it.
5' Betis can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
2' 0 - 1 Willian Jose (Betis) finds the back of the net! He latched on to a sweet pass into the box and fired into the roof of the net.
